title: The Missing Autopsy
author: Vesper Vasquez
blurb: Dominic Amberdale, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
